mechanism_claims.claim_text: The gp41w-derived peptides interact with lipid bilayers; fluorescence, calcein leakage, DSC, CD, and NMR provide direct biophysical evidence for membrane association/disruption phenotypes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: These assays support membrane interaction/disruption behavior, not a single resolved bacterial killing pathway.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: gp41w-FKA is the only Table 1 peptide with clear antibacterial MIC/MBC activity, but the discussion explicitly treats its stronger antibacterial effect as not fully explained by simple membrane disruption alone.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote this to a resolved direct antimicrobial mechanism; preserve uncertainty.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NMR and supporting information indicate gp41w-4R, gp41w-KA, and gp41w-FKA adopt largely helical conformations in the cosolvent structure work, with gp41w-FKA showing pronounced amphipathic character.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural support is mechanistic context only and does not define target-cell lethality by itself.
